static-panorama.name: Static panorama
static-panorama.use: the view is the star: grand vistas, waterfalls, light events; the safest move from a single photo
static-panorama.prompt: THE CAMERA IS COMPLETELY LOCKED OFF for the whole shot: it does not pan, tilt, slide, drift, push in, pull out or zoom; every mountain, cliff and building stays at exactly the same pixel position and size; the framing of the last frame is identical to the first frame and nothing new comes into view at any edge; only nature moves.

slow-push-in.name: Slow push-in
slow-push-in.use: draws the eye to one subject (a waterfall, a village, a lone tree); the payoff segment of most structures
slow-push-in.prompt: One slow, steady forward push-in toward {focus} at a constant gentle speed, perfectly level, no rotation, no tilt; over the whole shot {focus} grows to about 1.2 times its starting size and stays centred; the edges of the frame only crop in, nothing new comes into view.

slow-lateral-tracking.name: Slow lateral tracking
slow-lateral-tracking.use: reveals depth along a shoreline, a row of houses or a lakeside; foreground passes, the subject holds
slow-lateral-tracking.prompt: One slow, smooth sideways glide to the {side} at walking pace, parallel to {focus}, constant focal length, never moves forward or backward, never zooms; {focus} stays the same size in every frame, the horizon stays level.

gentle-aerial-glide.name: Gentle aerial glide
gentle-aerial-glide.use: flying calmly over water or valley toward the landscape; immersion
gentle-aerial-glide.prompt: A slow, level aerial glide forward at high altitude over {over}, toward {focus}, at one calm constant speed, no banking, no rolling, no diving; the horizon stays level in the upper third.

gradual-aerial-reveal.name: Gradual aerial reveal
gradual-aerial-reveal.use: wonder and discovery: hides the view behind a ridge, cliff edge or cloud, then lets it open
gradual-aerial-reveal.prompt: The aerial view starts low behind {cover}, then rises slowly and steadily over it at one calm speed, so that {focus} gradually opens up beyond it; no sudden move, the horizon stays level, the rise eases out and holds for the last two seconds.

low-angle-environmental.name: Low-angle environmental
low-angle-environmental.use: foreground texture (wildflowers, rocks, grass, ice) close at the bottom, the grand view towering behind; scale and intimacy
low-angle-environmental.prompt: Low angle at ground level: {foreground} sharp and close in the lower third, {focus} towering behind; the view almost holds still, with only a very slow forward creep through the foreground at a constant speed; the horizon stays level.

slow-crane-rise.name: Slow crane rise
slow-crane-rise.use: lifts from a close foreground up to the wide view; calm grand-scale opening or ending
slow-crane-rise.prompt: One slow vertical rise straight up from just above {foreground} at a constant gentle speed, the view tilting gently to stay on {focus}; the rise eases out and holds still for the last two seconds; no sideways drift.

foreground-parallax.name: Foreground parallax
foreground-parallax.use: branches, rocks or flowers slide past in front while the distant view barely moves; strong depth
foreground-parallax.prompt: A slow sideways glide to the {side} past {foreground} close in front, which slides across the frame, while {focus} far behind stays almost fixed; one constant calm speed, constant focal length, level horizon.

long-lens-compressed.name: Long-lens compressed panorama
long-lens-compressed.use: stacks ridges, dunes or rooftops into layers; telephoto look, distant haze between layers
long-lens-compressed.prompt: Telephoto view that compresses {focus} into stacked layers with soft atmospheric haze between them; the view is held completely still, framing identical from the first to the last frame, only nature moves.

controlled-panoramic-sweep.name: Controlled panoramic sweep
controlled-panoramic-sweep.use: a wide view too big for one frame; one slow horizontal turn across it
controlled-panoramic-sweep.prompt: One slow, steady horizontal pan to the {side} across {focus}, about a quarter of the frame width over the whole shot, at a constant speed, perfectly level, no tilt, no zoom; the pan eases out and holds still for the last second.

slow-overhead.name: Slow overhead observation
slow-overhead.use: top-down patterns: surf on sand, turquoise water over reef, braided rivers, dunes, ice
slow-overhead.prompt: Straight top-down aerial view looking directly down at {focus}; the view drifts very slowly forward at a constant speed, no rotation, no zoom; patterns stay sharp and geometric.

multi-shot-sequence.name: Multi-shot cinematic sequence
multi-shot-sequence.use: two or three calm shots cut on the music: hook view, the move, a closing view that loops
multi-shot-sequence.prompt: Each shot uses its own move below, with the same light, weather and colour grade in every shot.

A.name: Wonder and Discovery
A.title: Discovering {place}
arc: {focus} at once in full light, the most striking angle of {place}, instantly beautiful
the view of {place} opens wider than expected around {focus}
{focus} in full, held still so the eye settles

B.name: Peaceful Immersion
B.title: Quiet Hours at {place}
arc: a calm, beautiful view of {focus} with gentle natural motion
a slow, almost meditative drift through {place}
{focus} settles in the same calm view; the last frame matches the first for a loop

C.name: Grand Scale
C.title: The Scale of {place}
arc: a tiny boat, house or road dwarfed by {focus}, so the scale is felt at once
the landscape of {place} reaching far beyond {focus}
the whole of {place} held wide, {focus} small within it

D.name: Intimate Natural Detail
D.title: Up Close: {place}
arc: a vivid close natural detail of {place} (flowers, moss, wet rock, ice, ripples) with {focus} soft behind
the detail and {focus} together, both sharp

E.name: Atmospheric Transformation
E.title: {place}, Transformed
arc: {place} before the change: mist, first light or clouds on the peaks around {focus}
the change: light spreads, mist lifts or clouds roll over {focus}

F.name: Cinematic Multi-shot
F.title: {place} in Three Moments
arc: {focus} in full view at once, from its most striking angle
a calm, wide view of {place} that settles and flows back into the opening

landmark-full.name: Landmark in full light
landmark-full.line: The first frame is already the most famous, most beautiful view of {place}, in full light, sharp and composed; no empty sky, no slow fade in.

light-event.name: Light breaking through
light-event.line: The first frame shows sunlight already breaking across {focus}, rays or a bright edge of light on the terrain; no dark empty opening.

motion-event.name: Nature in motion
motion-event.line: The first frame is already full of natural motion on {focus}: falling water, breaking surf or drifting mist, so the eye catches movement at once.

scale-cue.name: Tiny against huge
scale-cue.line: The first frame shows a tiny human-made detail (a boat, a house, a road) against the enormous landscape, so the scale is felt at once.

reflection.name: Mirror reflection
reflection.line: The first frame shows {focus} mirrored in still water, a perfect symmetrical reflection.

colour-pop.name: Colour contrast
colour-pop.line: The first frame is built on one strong natural colour contrast (turquoise water against dark rock, golden grass against snow) in clear light.

golden-sunrise.name: Golden-hour sunrise
golden-sunrise.line: early morning golden hour, low warm sun from the {sun}, long soft shadows, cool shadows and warm highlights

golden-sunset.name: Golden-hour sunset
golden-sunset.line: late afternoon golden hour, low warm sun from the {sun}, warm amber light on the slopes, long shadows

blue-hour.name: Blue hour
blue-hour.line: blue hour just after sunset, soft cool even light, deep blue sky with a faint warm glow on the horizon, first lights in windows

misty-morning.name: Misty morning
misty-morning.line: early morning, soft diffused light, low mist lying in the valley and on the water, calm air

soft-overcast.name: Soft overcast
soft-overcast.line: bright soft overcast, even light without hard shadows, rich natural colours, calm air

after-rain.name: After-rain clarity
after-rain.line: just after rain, crystal-clear air, wet glistening rock, fresh saturated greens, broken clouds with sun patches

dramatic-storm.name: Dramatic storm light
dramatic-storm.line: dark storm clouds over the peaks with a shaft of sunlight lighting {focus}, moody contrast, no rain on the lens

clear-midday.name: Clear bright day
clear-midday.line: clear sunny day, high sun, deep blue sky, crisp natural colours, true-to-life water colour

aurora-night.name: Aurora night
aurora-night.line: clear Arctic night, green aurora curtains rippling slowly overhead, stars, the landscape lit faintly by snow and aurora

from-photo.name: Light of the reference photo
from-photo.line: exactly the light, sun direction, sky and weather of the reference photograph

felt-piano.name: Ambient felt piano
felt-piano.style: ambient cinematic instrumental, soft felt piano, warm string pads, gentle swell, peaceful, no drums, no vocals

orchestral-epic.name: Epic orchestral
orchestral-epic.style: cinematic orchestral instrumental, low strings, french horns, timpani swell, majestic and wide, no vocals

nordic-folk.name: Nordic folk
nordic-folk.style: nordic folk instrumental, hardanger fiddle, nyckelharpa, frame drum, airy, majestic and calm, no vocals

ethereal-pads.name: Ethereal ambient
ethereal-pads.style: ethereal ambient instrumental, soft synth pads, slow shimmering textures, distant bells, dreamy, no drums, no vocals

acoustic-warm.name: Warm acoustic
acoustic-warm.style: warm acoustic instrumental, fingerpicked guitar, light cello, soft hand percussion, gentle and hopeful, no vocals

asian-traditional.name: East Asian traditional
asian-traditional.style: cinematic east asian instrumental, guzheng, bamboo flute, soft erhu, light strings, serene, no vocals

desert-world.name: Desert world
desert-world.style: cinematic desert instrumental, oud, duduk, low frame drum, warm drones, spacious, no vocals

tropical-calm.name: Tropical calm
tropical-calm.style: calm tropical instrumental, marimba, soft nylon guitar, light shaker, warm pads, relaxed, no vocals

ambience.waterfall: the deep steady roar of falling water, softer far away
ambience.sea: waves breaking and washing up, sea breeze, distant gulls
ambience.lake: gentle lapping water, soft breeze, a distant bird
ambience.river: a rushing river over stones, breeze in the trees
ambience.mountain: high mountain wind, a distant bird of prey
ambience.snow: cold soft wind, faint creak of ice
ambience.desert: dry wind over sand, deep silence
ambience.town: faint distant town sounds, church bells far away, birds

water.falls: THE WATERFALLS MUST VISIBLY FALL, FAST: the white water races from the lip to the base in about three seconds and its white pattern is completely different every half second; the cliffs beside it stay perfectly still.
water.sea: Waves break on the shore and rocks at irregular moments and spots, foam runs up, slides back and dissolves; the open surface rises and falls with small ripples and twinkling glints and does not flow, stream or slide in any direction as one sheet; rocks stay fixed.
water.lake: Small wind ripples travel across the water in one direction toward the shore, reflections break into moving streaks and re-form, through the whole shot.
water.river: The river flows downstream at real speed, white water over the stones, ripples travelling with the current.
water.none: Only grass, leaves and thin mist move gently in the wind at real speed; rock and buildings stay rigid.

allowed: sunrise light spreading across the slopes
sunset light fading on the peaks
cloud shadows sweeping over the land
timelapse.line: SELECTIVE TIME-LAPSE ON THE SKY ONLY: {event} at an accelerated, smooth, even pace; everything on the ground stays real-time: water, waves, animals, people and boats move at their true real-world speed, never sped up.

avoid: No oversaturated colours, no HDR halos, no fantasy landscapes, no invented or moved landmarks, no duplicated or mirrored mountains, no warped buildings, no unnatural waves, no frozen or looping water, no flickering light, no camera shake, no text, no watermarks, no people appearing or disappearing. The camera is never seen: no tripod, camera or equipment appears anywhere in the picture.
